page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The processor is an Intel Xeon 8163. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance offers a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps, supporting high-throughput data transfers.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high-density memory profile position this instance as a stable resource for enterprise workloads. Since there are no integrated GPUs or local storage drives, users avoid paying for unused hardware components. This configuration is suitable for multi-threaded applications, enterprise databases, web serving, and general-purpose business applications requiring consistent CPU performance and high network throughput.
